theory: The intro incorrectly implies that all three derivatives are derived from $x=\sin y$. State that inverse sine uses $x=\sin y$, inverse cosine uses $x=\cos y$, and inverse tangent uses $x=\tan y$, differentiating and taking the reciprocal in each case. Add $-1<x<1$ to the standard inverse-cosine derivative fact to exclude its undefined endpoints.
